**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — no redline proposed.**

The only Customer-side commitment is the monthly fee floor in § 5(a) ("but not less than $____ per month..."). It clears the fallback checklist on its material terms:

1. **Limited to the current 12-month term** — § 13 (p0078): effective "for a period of 1 year," renewing only in successive one-year periods with a 30-day non-renewal right for either party.
2. **Exit on roughly 30 days' notice** — § 14 (p0079): services continue only until the last day of the month following our written notice of election to terminate; an unconditional Client election, so we can walk away from the floor mid-term.
3. **No penalty** — the minimum is a pure fee floor; there is no shortfall charge, acceleration or liquidated-damages mechanic anywhere in the document.

Noted in the rationale rather than redlined (minor sub-elements): the exit tail can stretch to ~60 days rather than a clean 30; the exit is framed as termination rather than partial reduction; and the blank dollar figures plus the misnumbered cross-references ("minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4" in § 6, "Subject to Section 4" in § 14 — the minimums are in § 5) should be completed and conformed at signature.

I also checked and excluded the § 3(i) credit-report sourcing requirement: it bites only if we choose to use the Interface, and § 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to use alternatives, so it is not a volume commitment under MINCOMMIT.
